itens.trecho: O filme é bom e ainda merece parabéns, mas apresenta falhas importantes. Este filme, lançado mais de dez anos após o último filme da trilogia original, marca o início da segunda trilogia da Star Wars, uma prequela dos filmes originais. Se a primeira trilogia foi a história de Luke Skywalker, a segunda é a de Darth Vader.

If it were the first "Star Wars" movie, "The Phantom Menace" would be hailed as a visionary breakthrough. But this is the fourth movie of the famous series, and we think we know the territory; many of the early reviews have been blase, paying lip service to the visuals and wondering why the characters aren't better developed.

So I watched this at a midnight screening when it was released (the first time midnight screenings happened...). The blast of horns for John Willams' score occurred and the title scrawl happened, droidikas appeared - I had a buzz going. But that buzz got less and less as the film wore on.
